name: minigrove
description: Read MiniGrove projects and direct their existing computers from your conversation.

interface.longDescription: Read your authorized MiniGrove projects and tasks, create and start a new task on an existing computer, continue existing work, inspect results and previews, or request a remote stop. Requires a MiniGrove account, project membership and explicit consent for each action. Your project computer executes the work. New task creation requires a supported computer and its separate permission. Accepted work continues after the client closes. Use MiniGrove workspace links for permission answers, merging and formal publication.
defaultPrompt: List my authorized MiniGrove projects and summarize active tasks.
Create a read-only workspace check task on my chosen project computer.

publication.release_notes: Create and start tasks through a separate permission, then follow preparation, execution and exact results in the native conversation.

zh-CN.subtitle: 在对话中管理 MiniGrove 项目
zh-CN.description: 查看已授权的项目和任务，在已有电脑上创建并启动任务，继续工作、查看执行结果和预览，或请求停止。需要 MiniGrove 账号、项目成员资格及单独授权。已有电脑负责执行；关闭客户端不会取消已接受的任务。需要本人处理权限、合并或正式发布时，打开返回的 MiniGrove 页面。
